body:
Northwind Robotics is hiring a Machine Learning Engineer Intern.

Join our perception team for a 6-month internship building ML pipelines for warehouse robots.

Requirements:
- Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
- Experience with Python.
- Familiarity with PyTorch or TensorFlow.

Nice to have:
- Experience with Docker.
- Exposure to computer vision.

Bluefin Retail is hiring a Data Analyst.

Analyse sales and inventory data and build dashboards for store operations.

Requirements:
- Strong proficiency in SQL.
- Experience with Excel and Tableau or Power BI.
- Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field.

Nice to have:
- Experience with Python for data analysis.

Ledgerly is hiring a Backend Engineer (Python).

Build and operate the APIs behind our accounting platform.

Requirements:
- 3+ years of experience building backend services.
- Experience with Python and FastAPI.
- Experience with PostgreSQL.

Nice to have:
- Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
- Experience with AWS.

Pixel Harbor is hiring a Frontend Developer (React).

Build accessible, fast user interfaces for our design collaboration product.

Requirements:
- 1+ years of experience with React and TypeScript.
- Solid knowledge of HTML and CSS.

Nice to have:
- Experience with Next.js.

Cedar Health Analytics is hiring a Data Scientist.

Develop predictive models that help hospitals plan staffing and capacity.

Requirements:
- 2+ years of experience in data science.
- Experience with Python, pandas and scikit-learn.
- Master's degree in Statistics, Computer Science or a related field.

Nice to have:
- Experience with SQL.

Northwind Robotics is hiring a ML Engineer.

Ship machine learning models to production for our robot fleet.

Requirements:
- Experience with Python and SQL.
- Experience deploying models with Docker on AWS.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.

Nice to have:
- Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
- Experience with Kubernetes.

Quanta Labs is hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer.

Lead the design of large-scale recommendation systems.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of experience building machine learning systems.
- Experience with Python, PyTorch and Spark.

Nice to have:
- Experience with Kubernetes and Terraform.

Stratus Cloudworks is hiring a DevOps Engineer.

Six-month contract to modernise our CI/CD and infrastructure as code.

Requirements:
- Experience with Terraform and AWS.
- Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
- Experience with GitHub Actions.

Nice to have:
- Experience with Python scripting.

Open Meridian AI is hiring a AI Research Intern.

Research internship on evaluating and improving retrieval-augmented generation systems.

Requirements:
- Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science or a related field.
- Experience with Python.
- Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).

Nice to have:
- Published research or open-source contributions.

Tandem Travel is hiring a Full Stack Developer.

Build booking features end to end, from database to UI.

Requirements:
- Experience with React and Node.js.
- Experience with PostgreSQL.

Nice to have:
- Experience with Docker.

Lexicon Legal Tech is hiring a NLP Engineer.

Build document understanding models for contract review.

Requirements:
- 2+ years of experience with natural language processing.
- Experience with Python and PyTorch.
- Experience with Hugging Face Transformers.

Nice to have:
- Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).

Bluefin Retail is hiring a Data Engineer.

Build and maintain the data platform behind our analytics.

Requirements:
- Experience with SQL and Python.
- Experience with Apache Airflow.
- Experience with Spark.

Nice to have:
- Experience with AWS.

Pocketwise is hiring a Mobile Developer (React Native).

Part-time role building our personal finance app.

Requirements:
- Experience with React Native and JavaScript.

Nice to have:
- Experience with offline sync.

Tandem Travel is hiring a QA Engineer.

Own automated testing for our web and mobile apps.

Requirements:
- Experience with Python or JavaScript test automation.
- Experience with Selenium.

Nice to have:
- Experience with CI pipelines.

Pixel Harbor is hiring a Product Analyst Intern.

Help product managers understand how customers use our product.

Requirements:
- Currently pursuing a degree in any quantitative field.
- Experience with SQL.

Nice to have:
- Experience with Python.

Stratus Cloudworks is hiring a Cloud Engineer.

Design and run secure cloud infrastructure for enterprise customers.

Requirements:
- 3+ years of experience with AWS.
- Experience with Terraform.
- AWS Certified Solutions Architect certification is required.

Nice to have:
- Experience with Kubernetes.

Quanta Labs is hiring a Computer Vision Engineer.

Build visual inspection models for manufacturing lines.

Requirements:
- 2+ years of experience with computer vision.
- Experience with Python and OpenCV.
- Experience with PyTorch.

Nice to have:
- Experience with edge deployment.

Ledgerly is hiring a Junior Software Engineer.

Work across our Python services and React front end as part of a mentored graduate programme.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
- Experience with Python.
- Experience with Git.

Nice to have:
- Experience with React.

Cedar Health Analytics is hiring a Lead Data Engineer.

Lead a team of data engineers building our clinical data platform.

Requirements:
- 7+ years of experience in data engineering.
- Experience with Spark, SQL and Python.
- Experience leading engineering teams.

Nice to have:
- Experience with Airflow.

State Institute of Technology is hiring a Machine Learning Teaching Assistant.

Support lab sessions for the undergraduate machine learning course.

Requirements:
- Experience with Python.
- Coursework in machine learning.

Nice to have:
- Prior teaching or mentoring experience.
